== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ヴィアーズ</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ホス上にのみ配備する。それ以降はどこにでも移動できる。ただし場に敵の単一（＊）キャラクターが3名以上いる場合、配置することができない。同じ位置にいるスノートルーパーは全員、没収値に＋1。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ダース・ベイダーの命により、ホスの反乱軍を殲滅せんとするＡＴ－ＡＴ攻撃機甲師団の将軍。無慈悲で冷酷な男。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Veers.

'''Lore''' — The general of the AT-AT armored assault division ordered by Darth Vader to destroy the Rebels on Hoth. A merciless and coldhearted man.

'''Game text''' — Deploy only on Hoth. He may move anywhere afterward. He cannot be deployed if three or more enemy unique characters are in play. All Snowtroopers at the same location are forfeit +1.

The original English says “same site” for the Snowtrooper bonus. The Japanese face uses 位置 (location). Both print the same minimum opposing character count and stat line.<ref>[[:File:ESB2P-D-veers.gif|Original English face]], [[Veers]].</ref>
